narrative.overview: A separately branded microsite inside the Beautiflow repository. Cobalt fields and heavy, compact lettering frame an open collection of vector architecture specimens. It deliberately replaces the parent site's paper/evergreen/Bricolage identity within this route only.
keyCharacteristics: Open exhibit sheets, not nested cards.
Native geometry and recognizable service glyphs.
Inspectable source, notes and measured evidence.

rules.name: The Two Layers Rule
rules.body: Website identity frames the collection; drawing identity belongs to the individual specimen.

dos: Do preserve glyphs, measured labels, containment, explicit ports and connector paths.
Do distinguish native geometry checks from decorative readability and cloud correctness.
donts: Don't inherit the parent website's identity into this microsite.
Don't treat logical groups as VPC or security boundaries.
Don't add runtime models or execute visitor-supplied code.
